One consistent pattern is alternating operations:

- \(10 \times 2 - 14 = 6\)
- \(6 \times 2 + 10 = 22\)
- \(22 \times 2 - 14 = 30\)
- \(30 \times 2 + 10 = 70\)
- \(70 \times 2 - 14 = 126\)

So the next term is:

\[
126 \times 2 + 10 = 262
\]

<answer>262</answer>
